description:
Persist a component's accessibility state to the library manifest — tier, latest gate verdict, provenance, immutable audit evidence, reviewer attestations, public API surface, and any exceptions. The manifest is repo state: commit it.

This is what turns per-component verdicts into a governable library. Call it after a11y_release_gate so the verdict is retained, and record the API surface so a11y_consistency_check can compare components against each other.

Exceptions REQUIRE an owner and an expiry date; expiry is then enforced by a11y_library_status.

Returns (json): { path, component, total }.

api.description: Public API surface — used by the consistency checker.

expires.description: ISO date. Required — no open-ended waivers.

library.description: Library name, recorded on first write.

manifest_path.description: Override the manifest location (default ./a11y-manifest.json or A11Y_MANIFEST_PATH).

name.description: Component name, unique within the library.

tier.description: Risk tier: 1 primitive, 2 composite, 3 high-risk composite.

name: a11y_manifest_record
title: Record a component in the library manifest
